research_rules.price_acceptance: Use a dated exact official CNY price or current exact mainland listing only when it maps to the retained model/build. A current frameset MSRP may be recorded separately from a custom complete-build price. Keep USD/global references separate unless the candidate schema supports a sourced conversion.
research_rules.recording: Record one current dated mainland-observed-price ledger field per target so the completed broad price sweeps remain immutable; link exact source provenance, update candidate price fields only when price and configuration match, and preserve the prior unresolved disposition otherwise.
research_rules.stop_criteria: Process the six targets sequentially. Stop on exact price evidence or a concrete access, generation, build-mapping, seller, or package boundary. Do not infer custom-build prices from stock trims, contact sellers, or enter login/challenge routes.

tooling_prerequisite: The gap report selects the newest research status across the generic price field and scoped mainland-price aliases; a regression test proves newer focused attempts supersede older broad sweeps in the displayed gap status.
